fields.description: Program Description Advantage and Characteristic of the Programme Teaching Objectives To cultivate graduate with strong Clinical analysis and thinking skills, Proficiency in clinical laboratory routine examination, reference values ??and clinical significance; Be Familiar with the performance, use, maintenance, maintenance of various types of automation equipment and related computer knowledge; Grasp medical diseases, pathogenesis, clinical manifestations, laboratory diagnosis and differential diagnosis, clinical teaching skills. Course Structure 1. General courses: Dialectics of Nature 36class hours; 2credit Medical statistics and basic methods of scientific research 72class hours; 4credit Foreign languages (English, Japanese) 90class hours; 6credit 2. Professional courses: Iinternal medicine 54class hours; 3credit Molecular immunology 28class hours; 1.5credit The cellular and molecular physiology 36class hours; 2credit Medical molecular biology 36class hours; 2credit 3. Selective courses: Biology technology * 72class hours; 2.5credit Clinical cardiology 26class hours; 1.5credit Respiratory Internal Medicine 26class hours; 1.5credit Internal medicine –Gastroenterology 26class hours; 1.5credit Clinical endocrinology 26class hours; 1.5credit Clinical hematology 26class hours; 1.5credit Special Courses (1) Category of Disease : Be familiar with hypertension, Common arrhythmia, myocarditis and Common cardiac emergency etc.; knowing pericardial disease, Common congenital heart disease and so on. (2) Theoretical Knowledge : Understand the anatomy and features of cardiac conduction system; Acquiring modern concepts and treatment of heart failure, unstable angina classification and treatment etc. Internship and Employment A total of 3,541 graduates of our school graduate in 2012. There are more than 100 graduates get the job in National Key Hospital, like Beijing Shijingshan Hospital, The people\'s liberation army 306 hospital, chaoyang hospital etc. Advantage of Dalian Medical University International Cooperation With the extensive development of exchange and collaboration programs with other universities and institutions at home and abroad, DMU has established collaborative relationships with 75 universities and 38 research institutions in 27 countries and regions, including The State University of New York (America), Curtin University of Technology (Australia), State Medical University of VolgaDnepr (Ukraine) etc. School Archivement Both of the two direct affiliated hospitals have been authorized to be the first-rank hospital. As the biggest comprehensive teaching hospital and emergency center in the south of Liaoning Province, the First Affiliated Hospital has won the honor of "National Top 100". With the development of medical services, in 2003, the Second Affiliated Hospital successfully annexed China Petrochemical Industry Hospital Dalian Branch. Now, these two affiliated hospitals have gone into the leadership in China in the fields of multi-slice spiral CT (MSCT) coronary angiography, catheter ablation treatment for atrial fibrillation, integrated traditional Chinese and western medicine in acute abdominal diseases, etc. Moreover, interventional thrombolysis treatment for cerebrovascular diseases and the transplant operation have also achieved domestic advanced level. Faculty Currently, there are over 4,400 faculty and staff, doctors and nurses in the university, among whom more than 500 are professors and about 510 are associate professors, including over 500 Ph.D. and M.S. supervisors. At present, there are 1 national key discipline, 1 provincial key discipline on the first-level, 15 on the second-level, 3 post-doctoral mobile station, 1 first-level discipline doctor program, 12 second-level discipline doctor programs, 5 first-level discipline master program and 50 second-level discipline master programs. Meanwhile, there is 1 ministerial research institution, and 1 ministerial lab, 5 provincial key labs, and 6 key labs for provincial universities. In addition, DMU possesses 12 bachelor-degree programs. Note: The course requires students to pay the tuition or admission deposit before issuing the admission package.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. No Crime Record * 2. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 3. Bank Statement * 4. CV(with photo) Written in Chinese or in English 5. For In-country and Extension Students Passport main page (new and old passports), visa page (please ensure continuity) Proof of current enrollment Transcript for the current academic period Explanation of extension circumstances 6. For In-country Transfer Students Passport main page (new and old passports), visa page (please ensure continuity) Transfer certificate/No objection certificate Verification statement Transcript from the previous school Admission letter (in Chinese and English) * 7. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity). * 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. Notarized highest degree transcripts, and then get the notarized copy certified by local Chinese embassy or consulate. 1.Transcripts that are not in Chinese or English must be translated into Chinese and then notarized. 2.After notarization, they must also be authenticated by the local Chinese embassy or consulate (for countries that are part of the Hague Convention, an Apostille is required). 3.You must bring the original transcripts, as well as the original notarization and authentication documents, when reporting for registration. Otherwise, you will not be able to complete the registration. * 10. Notarized highest degree graduation certificate, and then get the notarized copy certified by local Chinese embassy or consulate. For students from countries joined Hague Conventions could provide apostille documents. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English need to be translated into Chinese during notarization, and make sure you bring all original application documents including these to China during registration. * 11. Two letters of recommendation Written in English from two respectable professors. including professors' contact no, email address and handwritten signature * 12. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. * 13. A Supervision Confirmation Letter issued by professors or associate professors More about the supervisor contact information: http://iec.dmu.edu.cn/gyxy/Faculty.htm 14. Qublications(catalogue or abstract) Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements The applicant must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. Should be between 20-35 years old, healthy. Has obtained bachelor degree with good marks. Has solid financial support to afford the study and living expenses in China. IELTS or TOEFL certificate. You can also provide an English proficiency certificate, like the certificate that could prove you were taught in English before, and there will also be an interview to check your English proficiency.​ Note: After accepted, students need to pay deposit one year tuition fee to university.
